verdict.rationale: Shortwave ships custom AI filters that auto-label, star, and archive using plain-English scripts, plus Bundles/Splits to categorize inbox by importance and one-click identification of important emails/todos, directly matching the triage story; community feedback corroborates the bundling/importance-sorting feature as effective ('top shelf'). Steerability is evidenced via the plain-English filter scripts, but missing for 10: explicit audit-trail/log of AI triage decisions and independent verification of filter reliability at scale.
